newsitem.title: USA: Deutsche MG names head of U.S. investment banking.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche MG names head of U.S. investment banking.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, the investment banking unit of Deutsche Bank AG, said Monday it had named C. Edward Carter, formerly of Merrill Lynch and Co Inc, to head investment banking in the U.S.

Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said Carter, who will become a managing director, will be based in New York and report to W. Carter McClelland, president and chief executive of Deutsche Bank North America and co-head of global investment banking for Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
Carter spent 16 years at Merrill Lynch and most recently headed the consumer group, which is the corporate finance unit for the retailing, food and beverage and consumer products industries.
